## History

Jerry Corcoran engaged in political dealings in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where he offered a bribe to [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md). This secret transaction was accidentally overheard by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) while she and her friends were attempting to stop Judson from renting his fences for medicine advertisements. Jerry's bribe inadvertently gave [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) the leverage she needed to bargain with Judson, who agreed to cancel the advertisement contract to keep his deal with Jerry a secret.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P58](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0058), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P61](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0061), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P62](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0062), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P64](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0064), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P65](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0065), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P66](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0066), +3 more_
